description: Re-pack terminal strips to the fewest terminals: each net becomes one jumpered run sized to its wires (block capacity), empty spares go, like signals sit together, unlocked terminals are renumbered 1..n (locked ones keep their numbers). Multi-level and diode/LED blocks, cabled nets, and nets whose wires don't fit a run's clamp range (block wire_mm2) are left as they are. With spare_terminal_pct set (update_project), each packed strip ends with that share of its used terminals as empty spare terminals. Device connections never change. apply=false (default) only reports the before/after counts; ask the user before applying, since terminal numbers change.
